customer_question: Did you find any problems with the ICS we submitted before it gets used for registration?
question_variants: Is our submitted ICS internally consistent?
Are any of our HID11 ICS entries contradictory?
Did you correct anything in our ICS before using it?
actual_issue: A customer's submitted ICS contained two mutually-exclusive HID11 items (Table 1, items 1/1 and 1/2) both marked as supported (YES), even though the specification requires that only one of the two can be supported at a time, and this needed to be caught and corrected before being used as the basis for the registration's Export ICS file.
plain_english_explanation: A product's feature checklist (ICS) sometimes lists two options that are supposed to be mutually exclusive -- a device can be one or the other, but not both. If a customer's checklist accidentally marks both as 'yes,' that's an internal contradiction that needs to be resolved before it's used to build a registration, since the registration system expects exactly one of the two to be selected.
consultant_answer: In the customer's submitted ICS, HID11 Table 1 items 1/1 and 1/2 were both marked YES, despite the specification stating they are mutually exclusive (1/1 is excluded if 1/2, 'Limited HID Host, Report protocol,' is supported; 1/2 is excluded if 1/1, 'General HID Host, Report protocol,' is supported). The attached Export ICS file was corrected to set 1/1:YES and 1/2:NO, resolving the contradiction.
decision_logic: A customer's submitted ICS should be reviewed for internally self-contradictory values -- such as two mutually-exclusive items both marked supported -- before it is relied upon to build a registration's Export ICS file or otherwise used as evidence, since registering with such a contradiction unresolved would not reflect a valid product configuration.
final_recommendation: Review a customer's submitted ICS for mutually-exclusive item pairs or other internally contradictory values before using it to build a registration, and resolve any contradictions found (selecting the single consistent value that matches the product's actual intended configuration) before proceeding.
risk_if_done_wrong: Using an ICS with an unresolved internal contradiction (such as two mutually-exclusive items both marked supported) as the basis for registration would not reflect a valid or consistent product configuration and could create downstream registration problems.
